answer: Gate each agent identity with a locked opal bond and a slow, glacier-like unbonding period, then cluster identities by shared funding and synchronized attestations; if one member is caught faking, the whole cluster is slashed. A Sybil farmer must post a fresh bond for every persona and cannot recycle capital quickly, so N fake identities cost N bonds up front plus the risk of losing all of them. Because payouts are capped per identity, each new terrace of the reward ladder adds expense but not proportional income, and the attack turns unprofitable before it can scale.
